Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a few proposed scheduling windows so we can kick off the MAP and start the evaluation sprint cadence. Goal is to align on stakeholders, roles, and an evaluation timeline we can share with execs.

Proposed MAP kickoff (pick one):
- Tue Jul 27, 2026 — 09:00–10:00 PT (preferred)
- Wed Jul 28, 2026 — 15:00–16:00 PT

Proposed evaluation sprint:
- Baseline & smoke tests: week of Aug 2 (Aug 2–6) — 1 week sprint with daily check-ins
- Optional extended evaluation: Aug 2–13 (2-week) if you want a deeper throughput/latency sweep

Attachments: novaprod_map_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft), evaluation-schedule.ics (proposed calendar placeholder).

Please: 1) confirm which kickoff slot works or share alternate availability; 2) list the internal stakeholders who should attend (product, infra, procurement/security if required); and 3) any hard constraints for the evaluation window (blackout dates, procurement timelines, or PO/contract gating).

Marissa from our Customer Success team will run the kickoff; Ben will be coverage for latency/cost/quant profiles. Laura will handle legal/contract flags if procurement needs to be looped.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this in the calendar.

Best,
Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
